pick_command.instructions: `step` is a Chinese test step written by a tester for a network device: the titles along one path of a mind map, joined by ' > '; the last parts are the action and the expected result. Each option is one CLI command. Which option is the CLI command that this step requires the tester to execute? A related command with the opposite effect or a different effect does not qualify. Choose `none` if none of the listed commands is that command.

criteria.A: pool create <pool_name> http — create an HTTP back-end pool
criteria.B: pool create <pool_name> tcp — create a TCP back-end pool
criteria.C: pool delete <pool_name> — delete a back-end pool
criteria.none: None of the listed commands is the command this step needs
